title: Mystery 'portal' in NASA Mars photo sparks lost civilization theories
excerpt: An image of Mars taken by NASA has sparked theories that the agency captured ruins of a lost civilization on the Red Planet.
content:
NASA's Perseverance rover is currently searching for ancient signs of life on Mars.

But an image from the robot's camera has led some viewers to believe it uncovered evidence of a lost civilization.

UFO researcher Scott C Waring shared the photo online, showing a stunning view of the Mars landscape littered with large boulders.

In the distance, however, one formation Waring believes is an ancient gateway left by a lost civilization.

Sharing a close-up of the site, he circled the feature resembling a tall, narrow doorway in the face of a jagged rock, with a dark center, tapered top and uneven stone edges giving it the appearance of a ‘portal' - as he wrote on the image.

'I found some ancient runes in a Mars photo today,' Waring shared on his website UFO Sightings Daily.

He also claimed to have found another formation supporting his claim about a lost civilization on the Red Planet. 

'A tiny doorway that measures about 7 inches high and 5 inches wide and enters a pyramid-shaped object,' Waring wrote.

An image from NASA's Perseverance rover has led some viewers to believe it uncovered evidence of a lost civilization

UFO researcher Scott Waring shared the photo online, showing a stunning view of the Mars landscape littered with large boulders, and pointed to what he said was a portal

While the formations resemble the structures Waring proposed, NASA has long maintained there is no evidence of extraterrestrial life. 

The mosaic shows boulders inside Jezero Crater, where NASA’s Perseverance rover was exploring in June 2021 using its Mastcam-Z cameras. 

It is labeled Sol 107, referring to the 107th Martian day of the mission. 

Jezero once held a lake billions of years ago, making it a key location in the search for signs of ancient microbial life. 

Waring's UFO Sightings Daily website features a range of NASA images he claims show proof of alien life.

In August, he posted a photo snapped by NASA's Curiosity rover on Mars in May 2022, which Waring and many others were sure contained a doorway.

The photograph appears to show a dark, rectangular opening cut into a rocky hill, which some observers have compared to the doorway of a primitive dwelling.

‘The entrance is approximately 6.6 feet tall and 3.3 feet wide, about the size of a doorway in an Earth home,’ Waring said.

He also included a shot of what he believes is a doorway among the rocks

He questioned why the rover did not approach the feature and speculated that NASA may have already investigated it without releasing the results publicly.

Waring did not explain how he calculated the alleged doorway’s dimensions or provide evidence that the space agency conducted a secret investigation.

Its actual size cannot be reliably determined from the panorama alone without knowing its precise distance from Curiosity or identifying a nearby object that could provide scale.

In August, Waring posted a photo snapped by NASA's Curiosity rover on Mars in May 2022, which Waring and many others were sure contained a doorway 

The apparent entrance could therefore be significantly smaller, or larger, than Waring’s estimate.

NASA has not commented on the latest claim, but the agency addressed remarkably similar speculation after Curiosity photographed another door-shaped feature on Mars in May 2022.

That opening initially appeared large enough for a person to walk through, fueling theories that it was evidence of an artificial structure hidden within Mount Sharp.

Closer analysis revealed that it measured only approximately 12 inches tall and 16 inches wide, roughly the size of a dog door.

‘The mound, on Mount Sharp, has a number of naturally occurring open fractures,’ NASA explained at the time. ‘These kinds of open fractures are common in bedrock, both on Earth and on Mars.’

Scientists determined that the earlier ‘doorway’ was a small opening created where intersecting fractures caused pieces of rock to break away.
